description: This is a shell script used for managing release versions, analyzing repository history, and updating component metadata based on git commits, PR labels, and component-specific YAML files.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays help and usage information for the script.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: get_pr_for_commit
methods.description: Retrieves the pull request number associated with a commit SHA.

methods.name: get_pr_labels
methods.description: Fetches labels associated with a specific pull request.

methods.name: compute_next_versions
methods.description: Calculates the next version and generation based on the current version, generation, and bump type.

methods.name: update_metadata
methods.description: Updates version and generation fields in a metadata.yaml file.
